body:
Triage: `pm:queue`, `domain:spec`, type Task. Test-only pin replacement inside `packages/spec` (literal `slice(0, 6)` → the derived rule PR #11044 already ships in `@objectstack/cli`), plus retiring the "grow the slate AFTER these six" comment. No contract acceptance change ⇒ Clause-② expected `no`. The "two homes" question (keep the cli pin as defence-in-depth vs remove) is the implementer's call to state in the PR body — either is acceptable, silence is not.

No rebuild limb needed and none claimed (relative import — correctly distinguished from the dist-reading sibling pin).

- One predicate (`orderingViolations`) shared by pin and positive control — no drift seam. Clause-② discipline kept (draft; label rode the PR carrier).
